author: voidloop
body:
IGN: Sayah_
Ban Reason: Hacked Client Found in SS (Wolfram)
Who banned me: Tazz after a screenshare.

Explanation:

First off all, I was hacking. I am very sorry for what I did. I was just in a silly mood, and decided it was a fun idea to hack, avoiding all responsabilities as a Referee and a Translator. I admitted to using Vape after the screenshare ended, however, I still believe the evidence found in the screenshare, for the client, Wolfram, wasn't enough. That isn't the point. I was indeed hacking, no matter what. I am very sorry for this, and I have been thinking about this for the last month, ever since I got banned, and it was indeed a very stupid decision. I apologize for doing so, and I do ask for a second chance. I think my behaviour in avicus in the last year, apart from this incident, was pretty good and I was even aiming to become a staff member. I have never been banned for hacking before, except over 1 year ago, but it was a false ban, by Liam(aka Mango_). I hope I can get a second chance since I am very sorry for what I did, and one thing I can promise, is that it won't happen again. I do still keep my point that the evidence found in the screenshare wasn't enough in order to ban me, and when asked for proof of it(of the screenshare logs, etc) I didn't get a response...



Thanks for taking your time reading this appeal.

title: Sayah_-Ban Appeal

replies.author: Tazz
replies.body:
First of all, you will be granted a second chance, and you have admitted to hacking which makes this a whole lot easier. The point is, I do not need 'evidence' to ban you, I know what I saw, I am/was at the time of the screenshare, 100% sure you were using Wolfram, and I can explain why, which I explained to James, who most likely re sent our conversation to you, but I know for sure Posighdun did. You never asked for proof directly. You had launched Wolfram at 00:46, and when I matched up that time with a time you launched Minecraft in one of your logs, you went straight on to Avicus. I gave you a chance to explain this before I banned you, and you failed to give any explanation as to why this would have happened.

Now, a month after your ban? No. I'm sure you know how appeals work, a user should wait 5-7 months to appeal. I would tell you to appeal in 4 months, but seeing as you were a staff member, setting a bad example for other users...
